verdict.rationale: Unstructured lets you create, update and run workflows through the Python SDK or REST endpoints, and you can trigger and monitor job runs programmatically. External event systems could therefore call these APIs to start processing, but that requires extra tooling outside the product. The automatic page routing is a fixed internal behavior, not a user-defined rule. Missing for 10: native event-based triggers (e.g. new file arriving in a source connector), user-defined rule/condition configuration, webhooks or schedules, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
